title: Apple Butter Bars
description: These apple butter bar cookies are made moist and tasty by using apple butter and feature a simple drizzled icing for a delicious dessert.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 13x9x2-inch baking pan.

Beat butter until creamy. Add 1/2 of the flour, brown sugar, white sugar, egg, apple butter, baking soda, and apple pie spice. Beat together until well blended. Beat in remaining flour and stir in raisins. Spread in the prepared baking pan.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until a toothpick in center comes out clean. Cool in pan on wire rack.
While the apple mixture is cooling, mix confectioners' sugar, vanilla, and 1 to 2 tablespoons milk in a bowl to a drizzling consistency.
Drizzle icing over cooled apple mixture. Cut into 36 bars.

video.description: The flavor of apple pie joins the soft comfort of your favorite snacking loaf bread in this delicious and easy recipe. Butter, brown sugar, eggs and flour are the base for apple butter, apple pie spice and plump raisins. After these moist bars cool, drizzle them generously with an icing of confectioners’ sugar, vanilla and milk. Grab a tall glass of milk or a cup of coffee and a friend and start snacking because they’re too good to eat just one!
